⚠️ This version of The Lost Land has been discontinued.
🔵 Move to the new The Lost Land [Remastered]: https://www.roblox.com/games/17715563868/The-Lost-Land-Remastered

🏝️Survive on a hidden island full of dangers, obbies, and mysteries. Build your base 🏠, farm your food 🍉, tame exotic animals 🦖, survive disasters 🔥, unlock exclusive items ✨, and explore the secrets of the island.

🌟Level up to unlock new areas, fight bosses, and get the best ore. How long can you survive on this island?

⚔️The island is full of challenges, but with the right mindset and skills, you can overcome them all.

🌎 Join the Group: https://www.roblox.com/groups/6419285
